scientific_integrity: The stated formulas are proved by rank-wise Burnside fixed-point classification. Direct finite enumeration is corroboration only; authorship, independence and publication priority are not certified.
scientific_limitations: Only orientation-preserving partial injections are treated, not oriented/reversing or noninjective extensions.
Automorphism-orbits of individual elements are counted, not all semigroup-conjugacy relations or group orbits on submonoids.
The full 2000 paper giving the original presentation was not available in the inspected lawful public sources; a broader prior cycle-index theorem could imply the formulas.
Independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
title: Dihedral automorphism-orbit census of cyclic-order-preserving partial permutations
